theorems.name: Submission.regcomp_exists_continuous_unit_form_approx
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (O K : Set (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n), IsFiniteMeasure ν → IsOpen O → IsCompact K → K ⊆ O → Integrable g ν → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (g x) ≤ 1) → (∀ x, x ∉ K → g x = 0) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ f : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n, Continuous f ∧ HasCompactSupport f ∧ tsupport f ⊆ O ∧ (∀ z, covectorEuclideanNorm (f z) ≤ 1) ∧ ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (covectorEuclideanNorm (f x - g x)) ∂ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
